tools.name: search_companies
tools.description:
Find Danish companies in the CVR register by name. Returns CVR number, name, status,
    address, legal form and industry for each match. Use get_company for full details.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description:
Full company profile from the CVR register: current name, status, founding date, address,
    industry, employees, production units, public contact details and VAT number.

tools.name: company_people
tools.description:
Owners (ejerregister), board, management, founders and auditors of a Danish company.
    Each participant has an 'enh' id that person_companies accepts.

tools.name: company_financials
tools.description:
Key figures from the latest published annual reports (revenue, gross profit, profit
    before tax, result, assets, equity) in DKK, with a link to the filed report.

tools.name: person_companies
tools.description:
All Danish companies a person is or was connected to (owner, board, management),
    plus bankruptcies of companies they were involved in.

tools.name: vehicle_lookup
tools.description:
Vehicle data from the Danish Motor Register: make, model, variant, year, fuel, power,
    weights, status, first registration, leasing, inspection summary and odometer analysis.

tools.name: vehicle_checks
tools.description:
Before buying a used car: manufacturer recalls, owner tax, current insurer,
    inspection (syn) history, liens and valuations when available.

tools.name: search_address
tools.description:
Search the official Danish address register (DAR). Returns address ids and coordinates.
    Pass an id to address_report for building and property data.

tools.name: cleanse_address
tools.description:
Match a messy free-text address to the official one (datavask). Returns the best match,
    match category (A = exact, B = minor fix, C = uncertain) and the address id.

tools.name: address_report
tools.description:
Everything about a Danish address: administrative areas, BBR building data (year built,
    areas, use, heating), dwellings, official property valuation, zoning, coastal flood
    indicator and companies registered at the address.

tools.name: reverse_geocode
tools.description: Return the nearest official Danish address to a GPS position.

tools.name: phone_lookup
tools.description:
Identify a Danish phone number: operator, mobile/landline/service, region, companies that
    registered it in CVR, and a spam/trust verdict from user reports.

tools.name: phone_spam_check
tools.description: Quick verdict for an incoming call: spam level, trust score, category and report count.
